params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:

The changes are minimal and focused only on the relevant parts of the code. The rest of the modifications are either whitespace cleanup or minor formatting adjustments that do not affect functionality or introduce unrelated changes. There are no additions or deletions of unrelated code, no variable renaming, and no extraneous print statements. Thus, the patch cleanly fixes the warning with minimal impact on unrelated code.
